name: CQL
description: Conservative Q-learning, CQL(H) (Kumar et al. 2020, CORL commit eeeeef2) offline on the training sessions only, logged from the five built-in strategies and their Dirichlet-noised copies, with a Dirichlet actor over the listed assets and cash. Conservative weight 1, gamma 0.99. The checkpoint with the best validation net Sharpe is kept. trials = 5: the default configuration plus a declared grid of 4 (2/4/8 episodes per behaviour, 1000-4000 steps, conservative weight 1/5), compared by mean validation Sharpe over the three ranked tasks and 2 seeds.
